FIDELITY AND COVERAGE.problem: This check guards a planned trap and the patch weakened it. asset_plan says style_02, 05 and 06 were shot in the after-weather half and must be brought to one look with the bright-morning frames (style_01, 03, 04). The old check compared garments on the same page: after-weather garments show no warmer or greyer cast than bright-morning ones. That comparison is inside one file, so it is atomic. The guide bans comparisons across outputs, not between elements of one file, so the 'was a comparison between garments' rewrite misapplies the rule. The new wording ('every garment reads in neutral daylight') is a loose absolute: two garments that each look roughly neutral but do not match would now pass. The cell for the 'garments look consistent' rule (R08) on each carousel page now rests only on this weaker check.
